description: This Python source file serves as a factory for generating FastAPI route handlers for container proxy endpoints based on a JSON configuration file. It dynamically creates request handlers with appropriate path signatures for different API routes, processes binary content requests, and registers all endpoints from the configuration to a FastAPI router, enabling dynamic and scalable API endpoint registration for container file management.
